app.name: NestMates
app.pitch: Expenses, chores, events, documents and conversations — one calm place for everyone in the flat, in French and English.

validation.email: Enter a valid email address, for example name@example.com.
validation.passwordRules: Use at least 8 characters, including at least one letter and one digit.
validation.privacyRequired: Accept the privacy policy to create your account.
validation.invitationCode: An invitation code has exactly 8 letters or digits.

codes.INVALID_FORMAT: This value isn't in the expected format.

codes.NOT_MEMBER: Choose someone who is currently in the household.
codes.DUPLICATE: Each person can only be selected once.

login.title: Welcome back
login.subtitle: Log in to your household.
login.invalidCredentials: The email address or password is incorrect. Check them and try again.
login.sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Please log in again.

register.title: Create your account
register.subtitle: Set up your space in under a minute.
register.name: Name
register.passwordHint: At least 8 characters, including a letter and a digit.
register.acceptPrivacy: I have read and accept the privacy policy, including the automatic translation of chat messages by Google Cloud Translation.
register.googleTermsLead: Automatic translation is provided by Google Cloud Translation.
register.emailTaken: An account already uses this email address. Log in, or use another address.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.subtitle: Enter your email address and we'll send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sentMessage: If an account exists for {{email}}, we've sent a reset link. It stays valid for 1 hour.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.subtitle: Your new password replaces the old one immediately.
reset.successMessage: You can now log in with your new password.
reset.missingTokenMessage: Open the link from the reset email again, or request a new one.

onboarding.title: Set up your household
onboarding.subtitle: Create a household for your flat, or join your flatmates with their invitation code.

create.title: Create a household
create.description: You'll get an invitation code to share with your flatmates.
create.name: Household name
create.alreadyMember: You already belong to a household.

join.title: Join a household
join.description: Ask a flatmate for the 8-character code shown in their household settings.
join.invalidCode: This invitation code doesn't match any household. Check it and try again.
join.alreadyMember: You already belong to a household. Leave it before joining another one.

expenses.title: Expenses
expenses.description: Who paid what, and who owes whom.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.description: Guests, repairs, parties and due dates for the whole flat.

documents.title: Documents
documents.description: Lease, bills, inventory and insurance, in one shared place.

tasks.title: To-do list
tasks.description: Household tasks, who they're assigned to and when they're due.

chat.title: Chat
chat.description: Talk with your flatmates — each message in your language.

household.title: Household
household.description: Members, invitation code and leaving the household.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: Your name, email, password and language.

empty.title: You're not part of a household
empty.description: Create a household for your flat, or join your flatmates with their invitation code.

invitation.label: Invitation code
invitation.hint: Share this code with your flatmates.

leave.title: Leave household
leave.hint: You can leave when your balance is settled: you don't owe anyone, and nobody owes you.
leave.blocked: These amounts still have to be settled before you can leave.
leave.confirmBody: You will lose access to its expenses, calendar, documents, tasks and chat. If you are the last member, the household and all of its data are deleted.

details.title: Your details
details.emailTaken: An account already uses this email address.

language.title: Language
language.description: This choice applies to the whole application straight away and is saved to your account.

delete.title: Delete account
delete.description: This permanently deletes your account and personal data.
delete.confirmBody: Your account and personal data will be deleted. This can't be undone.
delete.inHousehold: You can delete your account only after you leave your household. Open Household settings and leave once your balance is settled.

add.title: Add expense
add.description: The amount is split equally between the people you select.
add.success: Expense saved. The balances are updated.

balances.title: Balances
balances.hint: A positive balance is money the household owes this person. A negative balance is money they owe.

settle.success: Settlement recorded. The balances are updated.
settle.confirmBody: {{from}} pays {{to}} the full {{amount}} outside NestMates. This records that the debt is settled.

calendarPage.deleteBody: The event will disappear for everyone in the household.

documentsPage.empty: Upload the lease, a bill or another file the household needs.
documentsPage.deleteBody: {{name}} will be removed for everyone in the household.

footer.label: Footer links
footer.tagline: Shared expenses, calendar, documents, chores and chat for the people you live with — in French and English.

arrival.label: Welcome
arrival.lead: Shared expenses, a common calendar, important documents, chores and a household chat that translates between French and English — in one calm place.

enter.label: The home
enter.title: One home. Different lives.
enter.body: Everything your household needs, in one place.

expenses.label: Expenses
expenses.title: Know who paid. Know what is shared.
expenses.body: Keep things simple: record an expense, let NestMates calculate each share, then settle up.

calendar.label: Calendar
calendar.title: Know what’s happening.
calendar.body: Dinners, visits and household plans on one calendar that everyone can see.

documents.label: Documents
documents.title: Keep the important things where everyone can find them.
documents.body: The lease, the insurance and household papers, stored together for the whole home.

tasks.label: Tasks
tasks.title: Share the responsibilities.
tasks.body: Add chores, take them on and mark them done. Everyone can see what is left.

chat.label: Chat
chat.title: Write in your language. Everyone follows.
chat.body: Messages can be translated between French and English, and the original always stays alongside.

final.label: Together
final.body: Create your household and invite the people you live with, or join one with an invitation code.
final.joinHint: Have an invitation code? Create your account first, then enter the code.
final.login: Already have an account? Log in

expenses.title: Shared expenses
expenses.caption: An expense is recorded, split equally between three people, then settled.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.caption: A day is selected in the household calendar and its event is shown.

documents.title: Documents
documents.caption: Lease, insurance and household documents are sorted side by side.

tasks.title: To-do list
tasks.caption: A task moves from To do to Done and is checked off.

chat.title: Household chat
chat.caption: A message written in English is shown with its French translation, and a reply written in French with its English translation.
chat.question: Can someone buy milk?
chat.reply: Yes, I’ll take care of it!

login.title: Welcome back.
login.body: The door is open. Log in to rejoin your household.

register.title: Your new home starts here.
register.body: Create your account, then set up your household or join one with an invitation code.

forgot.title: Lost your key?
forgot.body: It happens. We’ll email you a link to get back in.

reset.title: A new key for your home.
reset.body: Choose a new password to unlock your account.
